subject: Staggered credit intervention & invoice migration: next steps for CoralWorks
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: accounts-payable@coralworks.co.uk
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-19 15:12 UTC
Subject: Overdue: INV-2026-117 (final reminder) / migration to CoralWorks EU entity

Hi Sophie / AP team,

Hope you're well. Our records show INV-2026-117 (issued 2026-04-01) remains outstanding: £40,250. Payment was due 2026-05-01.

I understand from our earlier call there's an invoicing migration underway to CoralWorks' UK subsidiary and that AP is awaiting the new remit details. To keep things moving and avoid service disruption, we'd like to propose a short-term, staggered payment plan while the entity migration completes.

Proposed simple option: 30% payment this week, 40% on 2026-06-01, remainder 2026-06-15. We'll pause further dunning and suspend late fees conditional on receiving the initial 30% and confirmation of the invoicing entity switch.

I've cc'd Marissa (collections) to coordinate timing and Laura on tax for VAT handling between entities. If this works, I'll share an amendment to the invoicing terms for signature and a one-page payment schedule.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: staged-payment-schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Sophie Allen <sophie.allen@coralworks.co.uk>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@coralworks.co.uk
Date: 2026-05-19 17:03 UTC
Subject: Re: Overdue: INV-2026-117 (final reminder) / migration to CoralWorks EU entity

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the note and for being flexible. Apologies for the delay we've been migrating billing to our UK entity and treasury has been slow to confirm bank details. We can commit to the 30% initial payment this Friday (2026-05-21) and aim for the next tranche 2026-06-01, as you suggested.

Two asks from our side:
- Please confirm whether Redwood will need a new purchase order once the remit switches.
- We need a short amendment that states the staged payments and that no late fees will be applied if we meet the schedule.

I'll loop in our finance operations if any wiring instructions are required.

Best,
Sophie Allen
Finance Operations Manager
CoralWorks Ltd.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Allen <sophie.allen@coralworks.co.uk>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-19 18:22 UTC
Subject: Re: Overdue: INV-2026-117 (final reminder) / migration to CoralWorks EU entity

Thanks Sophie  good to hear. Quick answers:
- No need for a new PO in our system for this single invoice migration; we can accept the existing PO reference but will attach an amendment to the SOW that notes the invoicing entity change.
- We'll draft an amendment that includes the staged payment schedule and explicit waiver of late fees contingent upon hitting the dates.

Marissa, can your team send the amendment (DocuSign) and the payment schedule PDF today? Laura, FYI on VAT: we will need a short statement on how VAT is being handled for the migrated invoice (reverse-charge vs. UK VAT registration) to include in the amendment.

Vivek

---Quoted message below---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, May 19, 2026 at 15:12 UTC
Subject: Overdue: INV-2026-117 (final reminder) / migration to CoralWorks EU entity

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Sophie Allen <sophie.allen@coralworks.co.uk>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20 09:08 UTC
Subject: Amendment and DocuSign - INV-2026-117 payment schedule

Hi all,

I've attached the staged-payment-schedule.xlsx and prepared a two-paragraph amendment that:
- Captures the 30/40/30 payment timing.
- Waives late fees for this invoice provided dates are met.
- Notes that Redwood's services will remain active while the schedule is being executed.

Link to DocuSign: https://docusign.net/CL-889 (amendment: "Amendment - INV-2026-117")

Sophie: please sign electronically and route to your AP team; our policy requires the initial tranche to be visible (bank confirmation or remittance advice) before we mark the invoice as "in payment plan."

Laura: any short sentence on VAT to include? If CoralWorks will remit under UK VAT registration, we should note the VAT number and whether reverse-charge applies.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Collections Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophie Allen <sophie.allen@coralworks.co.uk>
Date: 2026-05-20 16:35 UTC
Subject: RE: Amendment and DocuSign - INV-2026-117 payment schedule

Quick compliance note: if CoralWorks migrates invoicing to a UK entity, Treasury needs the new remit ICC/IBAN and the vendor record updated before we record the new receivable. Also, we should avoid credit notes across entities unless legal signs off on inter-company accounting.

Recommend:
- We accept the staged payments as proposed.
- Add a single clause in the amendment stating Redwood reserves right to reinstate late fees if any tranche is missed. (We can soft-pause this clause for initial agreement but keep it as protection.)

If Marissa confirms the DocuSign is live and Sophie sends the initial remittance proof this Friday, I will update AR and mark the invoice as "under payment plan."

Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Ops & Finance
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sophie Allen <sophie.allen@coralworks.co.uk>
Date: 2026-05-21 23:43 UTC
Subject: Leadership approval request: 30% credit and late-fee waiver for CoralWorks (decision)

Team—

Quick exec ask to close loop: CoralWorks has committed to the 30% initial payment tomorrow (2026-05-21) and to the staged schedule. They requested a formal waiver of late fees for this invoice only and a one-time 30% credit to reflect a reconciliation dispute on usage metrics tied to April deployment (they've provided an internal usage note).

I recommend we:
1) Approve the staged payment plan and waiver of late fees upon receipt of the initial remittance.
2) Offer a one-time goodwill credit of 30% (£12,075) contingent on CoralWorks signing the amendment and confirming the invoicing entity (UK VAT number) within 14 days.
3) Require that the amendment includes the reinstatement clause Kimberly proposed if any tranche is missed.

Marissa: confirm DocuSign name of amendment is "Amendment - INV-2026-117" and that documents are attached to the HubSpot record HS-107342.
Kimberly: please confirm accounting treatment for the 30% credit across entities and whether we should book it as a contra-revenue or a credit memo against the existing invoice.
Laura: confirm the VAT line to include ("Customer to provide UK VAT registration or reverse-charge confirmation").

If I don't hear objections by EOD 2026-05-22 UTC, I'll authorize Marissa to accept the agreement and apply the credit once conditions are met.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: amendment-entity-migration-CL-2026.pdf (PDF stub)
